description: This file defines the RevisionHtmlRouteProvider class in Drupal, responsible for providing routing for entity revision operations such as viewing, reverting, and deleting revisions.

classes.name: RevisionHtmlRouteProvider
classes.description: Provides entity revision routes for Drupal entities, including version history, revision view, revert, and delete routes.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Generates and returns a collection of routes related to entity revisions based on the entity type.

methods.name: getVersionHistoryRoute
methods.description: Returns the route for viewing the version history of an entity, if supported.

methods.name: getRevisionViewRoute
methods.description: Returns the route for viewing a specific revision of an entity, if supported.

methods.name: getRevisionRevertRoute
methods.description: Returns the route for reverting to a specific revision of an entity, if supported.

methods.name: getRevisionDeleteRoute
methods.description: Returns the route for deleting a specific revision of an entity, if supported.
